messages:
laura: Quick q — want to lock down SI co-sell intake 'stamp' for warm leads coming from the marketplace. Current gap: leads sometimes go straight to field AE without partner loop. How do we ensure partner visibility + clear ownership?

mike: +1. We need a minimal stamp + routing rules. Propose CRM tags: `source:marketplace`, `si_stage:partner-intake`, `partner_owner:<org>` and a partner_claim window.

asha: Agreed. Also require a 24h claim SLA unless AE manually claims immediately. If unclaimed, auto-assign to partner queue.

ben-salesops: That workflow is doable. Draft suggestion: 1) marketplace webhook creates lead -> 2) apply stamp tags -> 3) 24h claim window -> 4) auto-assign to partner queue (pilot flag optional). I'll draft automation runbook.

priya-silead: Important: include an account-mapping step (domain match + ARR band). High ARR accounts should trigger human triage (<=2h). Also, mark hardware interest upfront.

chad-gtm: Also add a joint-announce checkbox on intake form for leads that may become joint PRs or co-marketed pilots — we need early sync on messaging.

marketplace-bot: New marketplace lead created: lead_id=MP-11872, company=Greenleaf.ai, ARR_est=350000, tags=[marketplace, needs-si]

laura: Good example. Ben — can you own the automation + a short Confluence doc (intake + routing + partner ack webhook)? I'll own partner-side ops and pilot coordination.

ben-salesops: Will do. Draft by EOD tomorrow. Will include sample webhook payload + a tiny Lambda snippet for the routing.

ben-salesops: ```json
{
  "lead_id": "MP-11872",
  "source": "marketplace",
  "partner_hint": "greenleaf-int",
  "arr_est": 350000,
  "joint_announce_intent": false
}
```

asha: For claim routing, mapping rules proposal: ARR > 250k -> route to enterprise-si bucket; 100k-250k -> regional AE + partner notif; <100k -> partner nurture/self-serve flow.

priya-silead: Also ensure legal/compliance checks for hardware deals — add `hw_order: true` flag to route to partner ops and legal.

laura: Agreed. Also add `nda_required` flag so SLA is paused until NDA cleared.

mike: I'll update the intake form to include `joint_announce_intent`, `hw_order`, and `nda_required` fields.

priya-silead: Can we add a partner_accept webhook so partners can accept/decline a lead from their partner portal? That will reduce mis-assigns and surface partner bandwidth.

ben-salesops: Yes — plan: marketplace -> lead stamp -> send partner_offer webhook -> partner posts partner_ack/partner_decline -> CRM updates routing. Endpoint: POST /partner/ack.

chad-gtm: Rollout ask: pilot with 3 SIs + marketplace sellers next week. Who can volunteer? Need to validate tags, analytics, and partner_ack flow.

priya-silead: We'll pilot with AtlasOne and Symmetry; Clearpath can be third. Priya will coordinate partner contacts.

laura: Locking pilot list: AtlasOne, Symmetry, Clearpath. Ben — add pilot flag & analytics (claim time, ack rate, conversion).

ben-salesops: Added pilot flags + event tracking. I'll post the Confluence link once the draft is ready. :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Automation engaged: intake webhook -> partner-queue (pilot mode) for MP-11872.

laura: Thanks all. Plan: Ben posts runbook + Confluence tomorrow, Priya coordinates partner side, we kick pilot next week and reconvene after 1 week to review metrics. Tagging @chad-gtm @priya-silead for follow-up.
